gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-sedan: Sedan reads like a well-worn paperback, its mellow stroke weights and terminals held back from the curves feeling unhurried. Bruno Ace SC stays hairline-free beside it.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-sedan-sc: Literary and bookish, Sedan SC is a text serif with mild thicks. Bruno Ace SC spreads its beaded, open letters above it, and a long passage would still glide along in the softly modulated rounds below.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-shippori-mincho: Bruno Ace SC draws every line with no downstroke favoritism. Shippori Mincho adds a soft cadence of fuller stems and slimmer links beneath, so the display lettering and the classic serif text feel like two distinct voices sharing one page.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-shippori-mincho-b: Shippori Mincho B1 is a classic serif with a crescent-wrench c opened wide and hairlines of reasonable sturdiness. Bruno Ace SC wins on pure display attitude.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-spectral-sc: Spectral SC reads literary, with sturdy hairlines and wide mouths on its rounds. Bruno Ace SC sits above in its uniform, beaded strokes, giving the serif below a bold, futuristic headline to lean against.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-stix-two-text: STIX Two Text is an editorial text serif whose thins run only slightly lighter than its thicks, like a dip pen used gently. And Bruno Ace SC, built from one width of stroke, makes a long passage feel traditional beneath it.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-tai-heritage-pro: Letters spread out like beads on a long thread, each part carrying the same visual mass, define Bruno Ace SC. Tai Heritage Pro counters with tempered modulation and a clear channel into every round letter, keeping a dignified, editorial voice.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-taviraj: Bruno Ace SC strings its open, unshaded letters out like beads on a long thread. And Taviraj, with its moderate contrast and generous curve gaps, is what gives the pair its bookish steadiness.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-trirong: Trirong is a classic serif with gently flared curve ends. Bruno Ace SC brings its bent-paperclip lettering up top, and the light stroke modulation below keeps the page dignified rather than gimmicky.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-trocchi: Open apertures and a marker-like line weight that never swells make Bruno Ace SC instantly recognizable. Trocchi's text serif, thinning gracefully along its wide-open ring c, feels classic beside it.
